assertion.rationale: F17: zero Microsoft.Insights/actionGroups, metricAlerts or scheduledQueryRules exist anywhere in the estate (verified by repo-wide grep). IR-4 is tailored out of NIST SP 800-171, but incident handling capability is a CMMC-probed 800-53 family, and detection is its first phase. With no alert rule and no action group, there is no automated trigger for triage, containment or any other IR-4 activity - a security-relevant event is noticed only if an operator happens to run a manual KQL query. scripts/bootstrap/03-budget.ps1 is the one notification path in the system, and it is cost-only, actual-spend-only and unrelated to security events (see F15).

recommendation: Stand up at least one Microsoft.Insights/actionGroups and wire scheduledQueryRules against the security-relevant signals F9's diagnosticSettings will start collecting, so a detected event has somewhere to go before any incident-handling procedure - manual or automated - can act on it.
